messages:
aris: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few sales/GTM/partners clarifications so the AE and SE teams can action.
aris: 1) For inbound enterprise trials, should AEs stage as POC or Opportunity? 2) What’s the current channel on partner co-sell credits and deal registration? 3) Any updated playbook for Dedicated vs Hosted upsell? :thinking:
maya: Good q's. High-level: Treat inbound trials as POC until they hit an active production purchase (then Opportunity). We want to keep the funnel clean for forecasting.
maya: On partner credits — we’ve approved a pilot co-sell credit for certified partners through end of Q2. Details coming from GTM next week. No retro credits for deals closed prior to partners being registered.
maya: Dedicated vs Hosted: default to Hosted for faster time-to-value. Recommend Dedicated when the customer requires reserved capacity or strict data isolation (SLA + compliance). Product should publish a one-pager mapping common signals -> recommended deployment.
talia: I'll publish the partner credit pilot doc Monday and share registration steps. For AE/SDRs: use the new deal-registration form (link in #sales) so we can track co-sell conversions.
talia: For the Dedicated upsell playbook: short checklist — 1) customer compliance requirement confirmed, 2) throughput SLA request, 3) cost projection + migration plan. I'll drop the checklist in #sales later today.
zack: Quick note on partners: channel partners want clear margin guidance and a simple registration path. We’ll start a weekly office hours for partner ops starting Wed 10am PT.
jules: From product: we’ll add a small table in the docs showing tradeoffs (latency/cost/isolation) and suggested model variants. ETA end of week.
devon: For SEs: can we get a templated technical handoff for Dedicated migrations? e.g. expected timelines, infra checklist, sample terraform args.
talia: Yes — SE template incoming. Will include: infra reqs, model pinning guidance, and sample rollout policy for canary + rollback.
aris: Awesome. Two quick asks: 1) Can we get a one-line pitch for partners that AEs can use in outreach? 2) Who owns the cost calc for Dedicated quotes?
zack: I’ll draft a 2-sentence partner pitch and post it here by EOD.
maya: Cost calcs owned by Sales Ops with inputs from Eng Infra (for GPU sizing) and Product (for quantization/throughput assumptions). Sales Ops owns the final quote template.
aris: Cool — last thing: are we enabling any channel discounts for the pilot, or keep standard pricing?
talia: Pilot partners get a 10% introductory margin on co-sell deals for Q2 only. We’ll evaluate after the pilot based on conversion KPIs.
devon: Can someone confirm the KPIs we’ll use to evaluate the pilot? conversion rate, avg deal size, time-to-close?
zack: Yup — conversion, time-to-close, and incremental pipeline influenced. Also track support load for private deployments.
allhands-bot: Recording uploaded -> https://redwood.co/all-hands/recordings/1769005432
aris: Thanks all — I’ll summarize action items: 1) Talia: publish partner pilot doc + SE template; 2) Zack: partner pitch + office hours; 3) Jules/Product: one-pager on Dedicated vs Hosted; 4) Sales Ops: quote template and cost calc owner; 5) Maya: confirm pilot guardrails. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done or reply with blockers.
zack: :white_check_mark: will post pitch and office hours invite.
talia: :white_check_mark: publishing doc and SE template today.
jules: :white_check_mark: one-pager in flight.
devon: Thanks — I’ll prep a sample terraform snippet and timeline checklist and drop it in #eng-runtime.
aris: Great. If anyone needs me to loop into customer calls for handoffs, ping me. Closing thread. :v:
